spans.s: नै॑—दाघ (नै॑-), mf(ई)n. relating to the hot season, summer-like, scorching, Megh. (also ˚घिक, BhP., and ˚घीय, TāṇḍBr.)
नै॑—दाघ m. the hot season, AV.; TBr.; ŚBr. (˚घ॑) &c.
N. of a summer month, HirP.
नै—देशिक m. ‘executing orders’, a servant, BhP.
नै—द्र mf(ई)n. (fr. नि-द्रा f.) sleepy, somniferous, W.
closed (like the petals of a lotus), Śiś. vi, 43.
